description: Use when the user wants an interior sketch, model view, or design image turned into a photorealistic architectural render. Time of day and extra instructions are the only optional workspace controls.

additional_instructions.description: Optional user preferences stated in natural language. Do not ask for this when the request is already clear.

image.description: The room image attached by the user. Do not ask the user for file metadata.

download_url.description: A temporary HTTPS download URL supplied by the host. Never construct this from a local path.

data.description: The existing base64 image bytes. Pass them unchanged; do not regenerate or summarize them.
